text.title: Hotel stays against the booking site's commission statements
text.lede: Only the items with no partner, split by how long they have been open. Bars to the left are stays the hotel recorded that the booking site has not billed. Bars to the right are commissions billed for stays the hotel cannot find. The older rows at the bottom are the ones that will not clear by themselves.
text.chartSub: Open items at 31 March 2026, aged from the checkout date. Select a bar to list its items.
text.chartTitleAmount: Unpaired items by age, by commission amount
text.rightHeader: Booking site only: billed, no stay
text.leftNote: The site will probably bill these; accrue them.
text.rightNote: Each of these needs a dispute or a credit note.

labels.rightOnly: on the booking site’s statements only
